summary: The solution implements a reasonable regression pipeline with LightGBM and CatBoost, but suffers from critical data leakage. Standard KFold allows the same players to appear in both train and validation sets, and grouping features on a combined train/test dataset leaks test distributions into training. Additionally, it lacks basic data cleaning (FM03), uses naive ensembling (FM12), relies on a single metric (FM15), and entirely fails to report validation scores.
